resources.string: System CPU load is restricted by Android
Prioritizes game readiness and flags resource contention.
Strict thermal guard for maximum sustainable performance.
Profiles tune pre-launch checks and recommendations. Android does not let another app overclock the CPU/GPU or change the game’s FPS cap.
Extreme never bypasses thermal protection. Launch is blocked at unsafe heat levels.
Runs a real pre-launch safety check, opens the official game, then closes itself to release resources.
Android does not expose another app’s rendered frames through a normal public API. No FPS value is estimated or fabricated.
FPS data unavailable through Android APIs
Frame-time data unavailable through Android APIs
RAM, battery and thermal status are read only while this screen is open or when you tap Refresh. There is no overlay, polling service or background monitor competing with the game.
Temperature pressure is currently low. Real performance still depends on the game, room temperature and battery state.
The device is warming up. Lower in-game graphics, reduce screen brightness and remove a thick case if safe.
Android reports serious thermal pressure. Let the phone cool before using a high-performance profile.
Review power saving before a performance session.
Lower brightness manually when heat is building.
Review Android’s optimization list; no setting is changed silently.
No internet permission. No account data. No analytics. No root. No accessibility service. No game files are read or modified.

It can check device readiness, detect official regional packages, warn about heat and launch the game with minimal overhead. It cannot kill other apps on modern Android, change CPU/GPU clocks, bypass thermal limits, inject memory, alter anti-cheat, or unlock an FPS mode the game/device does not support.
The game can be launched. The optimizer will close immediately afterward so it does not compete for memory or CPU.
Launch is paused because the selected game is missing or current heat makes this profile unsafe.
The selected regional game package is not installed.
Android reports severe thermal pressure. Reduce graphics and let the phone cool.
The device is warming up; sustained FPS may drop.
Battery temperature is high. Reduce brightness and pause charging if appropriate.
Available RAM is low. Close unneeded apps from Android’s Recents screen.
Battery is at or below 15%; performance may be limited.
Battery Saver is enabled and may limit sustained performance.
Thermal status is not exposed on this Android version/device.
Some device data could not be read. Unsupported values were skipped safely.
The game could not be opened. Its installation may have changed.
This settings page is not available on this device.
